name: What is the typical process for a custom kitchen design project with Hometelligent Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a custom kitchen design project with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our custom kitchen design process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Following this, our design team develops detailed plans and 3D renderings for your review and approval. Once the design is finalized, we assist with material selection and provide a comprehensive proposal. The construction phase then commences, managed by our experienced project managers to ensure quality and adherence to the timeline, concluding with the final installation and walk-through of your new kitchen in your East Bay home.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process starts with a consultation, followed by design plans, material selection, and a comprehensive proposal. Construction is managed by our team, ending with final installation and walk-through.
